title: Brightening Face Wash With Vitamin C
description:
Brightening Face Wash with Vitamin C
A refreshing, clearing and detoxifying 3-in-1 wash, scrub, and mask. With the benefits of Licorice root extract, Prickly Pear extract and Vitamin C it scrubs out impurities, reduces pigmentation through gentle exfoliation, purifies skin without over drying and brightens complexion.
Active Ingredients:
1. Vitamin C:
brightens skin, hydrates skin, reduces pigmentation, protects against sun damage, promotes collagen production
2. Licorice Root Extract:
brightens skin, fades blemishes, eases and soothes skin inflammation, helps production of antioxidants which strengthens skin and prevents UV ray damage
3. Prickly Pear Extract:
promotes skin elasticity, softens skin, prevents wrinkle production, evens skin tone
What does it do?
- BRIGHTENING
- REDUCES BLEMISHES
- ANTI-AGEING
- ACTIVATES BLOOD CIRCULATION
- SUPERFICIALLY PEELS
- ANTI-INFLAMMATORY
- MOISTURIZING

Who is it for?
- All skin types

3 Ways to Use
1. Face wash
- Apply a small amount to wet face and neck, massage circular movements and rinse off. Use Twice a day.

2. Scrub
- Apply a small amount to wet face and neck, massage in circular upward movements for two minutes and rinse off. Use twice
week.
3. Mask
- Apply a small amount to wet face and neck, massage in circular upward movements for two minutes and leave on for five minutes. Rinse off. Use once a week.
